newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct electricity demand rises 3.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct electricity demand rises 3.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Demand for electricity supplied by nine key Japanese power utilities in October rose 3.3 percent from a year earlier to 60.3 billion kilowatt hours (kWh), the Federation of Electric Power Companies said on Tuesday.

Electricity consumption by large-lot industrial users increased by 3.2 percent to 22.26 billion kWh, marking a year-on-year rise for the second consecutive month, a preliminary report by the federation showed.
Growth stemmed from increased demand from steelmakers and firm demand from makers of electrical and transport machinery, the federation said.

Electricity consumption by households and offices also grew, with demand for lighting increasing by 3.8 percent year-on-year. Consumption in offices for purposes other than lighting grew by 3.9 percent, it said.
